audience: bookkeepers and accounting firms that process supplier invoices with Parseo

useCases.title: Upload invoice files and follow each job
useCases.text: Upload one invoice file, or up to 10 files in one batch. Poll the job until it completes, then read the extracted invoice.

useCases.title: Export processed invoices to an accounting system
useCases.text: List the invoices that are not exported yet. Export one as an Odoo or Rivile file, then mark it as exported after your import works.

useCases.title: Correct the fields of an extracted invoice
useCases.text: Read the invoice with its line items. Then send only the fields to change. A changed exported invoice is flagged as changed since export.

useCases.title: Keep clients and contacts in step
useCases.text: List the clients of the team and read one client. Create a client, or update its details, so its invoices use the right client id.

useCases.title: Check which uploads wait for credits
useCases.text: List the upload jobs and filter for awaiting_credits. Read the credit balance to see what those jobs wait for.
